commit.message: CI: use new resolver to test MSRV
CI: Use ARM runners for python builds

Properly evaluate `GRAPH ?g {}`

It should return all named graphs
left join: always return tuple after error from right side
CI: attempt for better cache effectiveness

+## [0.4.7] - 2025-01-19
+
+### Changed
+- SPARQL: `GRAPH ?g {}` now properly returns all named graph in the queried dataset.
+- SPARQL: `ASK { OPTIONAL { X }}` now properly returns true even if `X` raises an error.
+- `sparopt`: breaking 0.2 release because of the introduction of a `Graph` algebra node to support `GRAPH ?g {}` syntax.
+
+
